title: US cities with Waymo driverless robotaxi service

source.name: Waymo service area announcements
source.publisher: Waymo, via company blog and news coverage

notes: Waymo launched fully driverless service in Phoenix, AZ in 2020, added San Francisco (2022) and Los Angeles (2023-2024), then Austin and Atlanta in 2025 -- five US metro areas with public driverless robotaxi service.
